description: quartermaster: a SessionEnd tally of this session's friction (streamed locally, no LLM, no network) and a SessionStart line that keeps the capability-capture charter in front of Claude (turn the thing done three times into a skill, map entry, rule, or measurement) and has Claude run a resupply pass once enough unreviewed sessions or friction events pile up. Neither hook analyzes content or changes anything; all recommendations happen in the moment or inside the resupply skill, each with per-item user approval.
